[Informed] Perplexity Sonar Deep Research (1 - 3 minutes)

Part of [`seek research`](seek-research.md).

## Usage

```text
seek research perplexity [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Research question |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--model <name>` | Override model (default: sonar-deep-research) |  |
| `--effort <level>` | Reasoning effort: low \| medium \| high | `"medium"` |
| `--quiet` | Suppress polling progress on stderr | `false` |
| `--async` | Submit the research job and return without polling | `false` |
| `--json` | Emit JSON (raw job when blocking; lifecycle envelope with --async) |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek research perplexity` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek research perplexity --help`:

                    false)
